title: Free Recall with Closed-Loop Stimulation at Encoding (Encoding Classifier)
description: This dataset contains intracranial electrophysiology recordings and behavioral data from a delayed free recall task with real-time closed-loop brain stimulation during encoding. Participants studied word lists, performed distractor arithmetic tasks, and freely recalled words while an L2 logistic regression classifier trained on prior sessions predicted subsequent memory performance and triggered stimulation for low-confidence encoding events. Data were collected across multiple clinical sites as part of a collaborative memory research study.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG recordings were acquired during a delayed free recall paradigm with closed-loop stimulation. Neural features were extracted using Morlet wavelet transformation (wavenumber=5, 8 log-spaced wavelets 3-180 Hz) applied to bipolar recordings during 0-1366 ms post-stimulus intervals after 58-62 Hz line noise removal. An L2 logistic regression classifier was trained on encoding data from prior sessions using leave-one-session-out cross-validation. Stimulation (500 ms duration) was triggered when classifier output fell below the median training value. Recordings were acquired using Blackrock (250 nV units) and Medtronic (0.1 µV units) systems.
